name: Supriya
experience: Volunteering at Kanasu has been one of the most fulfilling experiences of my life. The community here, the people, the children, the environment and LITERALLY everything in general is extremely close to my heart. My Saturdays feel incomplete without Kanasu now. Teaching the kids too has been so rewarding for me, I've learnt to be grateful for the smallest things in my life. The kids' ever smiling faces, their curiosity, their jokes etc is something I shall cherish forever.

name: Adiya
experience: My volunteering experience at Kanasu was amazing. Volunteering at U&I was much much much more fun than I expected. I love the community, how everyone encourages each one. Getting to know such wonderful human beings who share the passion to do something for the society, and that too by teaching kids is just beautifullllll❤️

name: Vasudeva
experience: Kanasu has really been amazing and the journey in U&I organization was successful only because I was a part of the Kanasu family. Teaching has always been my profession and it got fulfilled here. The kids in the center are energetic as always and it takes a mountain of volunteers to control just one of them. But all my fellow volunteers have risen up to the situation and handled the task in the most creative way possible. The other volunteers are fun-loving and especially creative and talented . The leaders have been supportive throughout our journey. Overall it has been a wonderful and rich experience.

name: Manasvi
experience: Volunteering at Kanasu has been like an anchor in my life.. Every Saturday, I look forward to spend time with the kids and the amazing fellow volunteers...

name: Nyssa
experience: Joining U & I was one of the best decisions I've ever made. It's helped me break out of my introverted bubble. Every Saturday, I look forward to spending time with the kids, and it’s a wonderful escape from my hectic week. Through this experience, I've come to realize that being a teacher is no easy task, and I've developed a lot more patience along the way. Initially, getting the kids to sit still and focus was quite a challenge. However, I've managed to create an environment where they can engage in learning. I've emphasized that life is full of obstacles, but it’s important to face them with a smile every morning. Hearing them share the tough moments of their day and how they’ve tackled those challenges has been a remarkable achievement for me. It's truly rewarding to see them open up and grow.

name: Honnu
experience: Coming to the centre and teaching students is literally a stress free day. My schedule for the whole week will be very stressful and hectic but coming here will literally be refreshing and sort of a warmup for the upcoming week. Mainly I have learnt to handle my patience with these kids, and to interact openly with everyone. The best part is when the kids run to me and wish me every single day. Adding to it is the debrief part which I love to attend. Overall I love coming to the center.

name: Sushmitha
experience:
I joined Kanasu mid-year, initially I wasn't assigned any student so I would assist my fellow volunteers. Later after 3 to 4 weeks of joining I was assigned 1 student who was the naughtiest and hyperactive student in the center. Teaching him has been a wonderful journey for me. Initially I faced a lot of challenges, engaging the class for even 30 minutes felt impossible as he had a very short attention span and was more interested in seeing what his fellow students were doing. Situations like these very challenging at first and later this helped me to become more patient and ideate on a variety of ideas to teach in a creative manner and also transfer required amount of knowledge. This is how it helped me as a teacher.
As an individual Kanasu has taught me about how to appreciate small things in life. My fellow volunteers helped me do tasks out of box like socializing with new people. It has given me a new family to whom I can look you to and i am really grateful for joining Kanasu.

name: Sirikrishna
experience: Working at U&I has been the most interesting,fun, educative and positive experience throughout the year. I was mapped to a couple of other students, and I taught them what I could earlier. I made them play games and learn along, I implemented this thing called the clap strategy. Where the child claps with each letter of a word in order to memorise a spelling. I tried making it interesting, but in some ways the child didn't seem as involved as I expected them to be. I didn't feel good about being unable to change the attitude of the child towards learning. Meanwhile, the progress was still there! There was good amount of growth by the time I was mapped to another child. This new child I was teaching, was a vibe by themselves. He started to grasp things so quick, everything he heard - if there's playing/acting/drama in it. So I made his entire learning playful. He's growing very well - class by class. One sentence he recently said will stay with me forever. It was an activity where we had to ask the child to doodle their teacher and ask a few questions related to them. As per what I was given, I asked them, 'Who's your favourite hero?' and he said, 'Sirikrishna anna!' without a second of thinking. This wholesome moment is very rare, very thankful to U&I, the people who introduced me to it, and for what work U&I's been doing - for making us volunteers in this long journey - for doing all the service it is doing - with complete dedication. And for giving me this wonderful experience to teach, learn, work as a team, etc.

name: Ullas
experience: Volunteering at U&I has been a wonderful experience. The children's energy and eagerness to learn despite their other responsibilities inspired me. I feel I formed a bond with the system and team and Saturdays became something to look forward to. Teaching them basics and how to converse in English makes me happy.bI feel grateful to have met fantastic kids and an incredible team who always want to give at U&I. Contributing to this cause has been worth, and seeing the kids gain knowledge is truly fulfilling.My kids are a source of inspiration. Love U&I :)

name: Aruna
experience: When I first joined Kanasu, it was with a mind full of uncertainty. I was unsure if I could teach the kids something at all and make some difference to their life. But I saw their enthusiasm and I saw how motivated they were and I decided to go for it. Through Kanasu, I’ve learned patience and understanding, and I’ve figured out how to communicate even when language is a barrier. More than anything, I’ve realized that even the smallest effort can have an impact on someone else’s life. I hope that, along this journey, I’ve sparked curiosity in some children, encouraged them to explore, read, and discover more about the world.

name: Heer
experience: As a volunteer at Kanasu, my experience has been both rewarding and eye-opening. One of my main tasks was tutoring students in English but through time I learned their language of understanding & mine as well. Whilst my journey I shifted to tutoring maths which was short but equally amazing as english. It felt amazing to see the excitement on the children’s faces every week when we showed up. I also participated in fund raising and it was incredible to witness how a little extra support could make a big difference in their lives. The stories of my peers throughout their journey, listening to their grows & glows have motivated me to work harder for my kid. It's been a fulfilling journey, and I'm grateful for the impact we've made together.

name: Lahari
experience: These past 8 months of teaching have truly changed me for the better. It’s made me appreciate the small things we often take for granted. The amazing boys I’ve taught will always hold a special place in my heart! Every Saturday, the way these little ones greet me with so much joy is something I’ll cherish forever. U&I has done an incredible job organizing this journey—providing structured learning resources, assessments, and well-planned levels to ensure every child grows. And the content feeling you get after teaching a child for 8 months—knowing they’ve improved because of you? That feeling is just amazing. I wish and hope to make an impact like this every year. If you’re reading this, I nudge you to give it a try—because the joy and gratitude you’ll experience is truly unmatched (The kids might drive you a bit crazy 😜but trust me it’s worth it)❤️✨

name: Harsh
experience: I want to share my overall experience related to U&I and the Kanasu Center. I really had a very good time while teaching kids. I also learned a lot from them. I still remember the day when I was assigned to my kid. Earlier, he was kind of reluctant and didn't show interest, but after some time, it changed totally opposite, and the bond became so strong. We would spend hours exploring different topics, and I was amazed at how quickly he picked up new concepts. It was incredibly rewarding to see him transform from a hesitant learner into a curious and eager student.
